title: ygramela maritima
intro: Ygramela maritima, commonly known as Irish moss, is a type of red algae found in the intertidal zones of the Atlantic coast. This plant has been used for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues and act as a natural thickening agent in foods. The therapeutic actions of Irish moss include anti-inflammatory and anticoagulant properties, which help to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. Irish moss contains bioactive constituents such as carrageenan, fucoidan, and other sulfated polysaccharides, which have been shown to have antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects.
